youtube.baslik: In multifrequency tympanometry, can a flaccid drum mimic discontinuity? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In multifrequency tympanometry, an atrophic or flaccid area on the drum can give a notched, low resonance result that mimics ossicular discontinuity. Myringosclerosis plaques, on the other hand, stiffen the drum and can push the result in the opposite direction. So look at the drum before interpreting a multifrequency result, and interpret it together with the audiogram and reflex findings.
